blocks.text: Amides mein functional group -CONH2 hota hai. Carboxylic acids se ban sakne ki wajah se inhein kabhi acid amides kehte hain. Yeh acyl chlorides ko kamre ke darje par ammonia ya primary amines se react kara kar banaye jate hain, jis se hydrogen chloride ka safaid dhuan nikalta hai:

items: CH3COCl + NH3 -> CH3CONH2 + HCl (ethanamide); C6H5COCl + NH3 -> C6H5CONH2 + HCl (benzamide).

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-Cl + NH3 se CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + HCl. Neeche: benzoyl chloride (ring-C(=O)-Cl) + NH3 se benzamide (ring-C(=O)-NH2) + HCl.
blocks.caption: Acyl chlorides aur ammonia se amides (kitab ke PDF safha 127 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: CH3COCl + CH3CH2NH2 -> CH3CONHCH2CH3 + HCl (N-ethylethanamide); CH3COCl + C6H5NH2 -> CH3CONHC6H5 + HCl (N-phenylethanamide).

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-Cl (ethanoyl chloride) + CH3-CH2-NH2 se CH3-C(=O)-NH-CH2-CH3 (N-ethyl ethanamide) + HCl. Neeche: CH3-C(=O)-Cl + phenyl amine se CH3-C(=O)-NH-ring (N-phenyl ethanamide) + HCl.
blocks.caption: Acyl chlorides aur primary amines se amides (kitab ke PDF safha 127 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Banne wala HCl ammonia ya amine ke aik aur molecule se react kar ke namak banata hai (NH3 + HCl -> NH4+ Cl-; RNH2 + HCl -> RNH3+ Cl-), is liye reaction mukammal karne ko ammonia ya amine zyada use hoti hai.

blocks.alt: R-NH2 + HCl se R-NH3(+) Cl(-). Neeche: NH3 + HCl se NH4(+) Cl(-).
blocks.caption: Amine aur ammonia ka HCl se namak banana (kitab ke PDF safha 128 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Tabeei khasiyatein
blocks.text: Methanamide, jo maaye hai, ke siwa sab amides tez pighalne ke darjon wale thos hain, aur molecules ke darmiyan mazboot hydrogen bonding ki wajah se in ke ubalne ke darje kaafi oonche hain. N-substituted amides mein alkyl substituents barhne se pighalne aur ubalne ke darje ghat'te hain, kyunke hydrogen bonding ke liye N-H hydrogens kam hote hain.

Amides aliphatic amines se kaheen kamzor bases hain; amines ke baraks yeh paani mein neutral mehlool banate hain. In mein resonance hai: nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl group ke oxygen ki taraf delocalised hota hai (R-CO-NH2 <-> R-C(O-)=NH2+), jis se nitrogen ke electrons kam dastiyab hote aur basicity ghat'ti hai. Carbon aur nitrogen ke darmiyan juzwi double bond ki khasiyat amide ke C-N bond (132 pm) ko aam C-N single bond (147 pm) se chhota bhi karti hai.

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-NH2 jis ke N par lone pair aur do curly arrows hain (C=O ke electrons O par; N ka lone pair C-N bond mein), double-headed resonance teer, aur R-C(-O-)=NH2+.
blocks.caption: Amide mein resonance (kitab ke PDF safha 128 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehli banawat mein C=O ke electrons oxygen par jate hain aur nitrogen ka lone pair C-N bond mein aa jata hai. Doosri banawat mein oxygen manfi aur nitrogen musbat hai aur C=N double bond hai. Asal amide in dono ke beech hai, is liye nitrogen ka lone pair kam dastiyab hai (amide kamzor base) aur C-N bond aam single bond (147 pm) se chhota (132 pm) hai.

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-NH2 ke C-N bond ki taraf teer, label (132 pm); aur R-CH2-NH2 ke C-N bond ki taraf teer, label (147 pm).
blocks.caption: Amide aur amine mein C-N bond ki lambai (kitab ke PDF safha 128 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Amides sab se kam reactive tezaab derivatives hain, kyunke carbonyl oxygen par delocalised nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl carbon ka juzwi musbat charge (electrophilic taqat) kam karta hai. In ke reactions sust hain aur lambi garmi ya catalyst (tezaab ya base) chahte hain.

items: Tezaabi hydrolysis se carboxylic acid aur ammonium namak: CH3CONH2 + H2O + HCl -> CH3COOH + NH4Cl.
Base ki madad se hydrolysis se tezaab ka namak aur ammonia: CH3CONH2 + NaOH -> CH3COONa + NH3; azad tezaab halke HCl se milta hai: CH3COONa + HCl -> CH3COOH + NaCl.
Khushk ethoxyethane (ether) mein lithium tetrahydridoaluminate(III) se reduction primary amines deti hai: CH3CONH2 + 4[H] -> CH3CH2NH2 + H2O; C6H5CONH2 + 4[H] -> C6H5CH2NH2 + H2O (phenylmethanamine).

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + H2O + HCl se CH3-C(=O)-OH + NH4Cl.
blocks.caption: Ethanamide ki tezaabi hydrolysis (kitab ke PDF safha 128 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + NaOH se CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + NH3. Neeche: CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + HCl se CH3-C(=O)-OH + NaCl.
blocks.caption: Ethanamide ki base hydrolysis aur namak se tezaab (kitab ke PDF safha 129 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + 4[H], teer ke oopar LiAlH4 aur neeche Dry ether, se CH3-CH2-NH2 + H2O. Neeche: benzamide (benzene ring-C(=O)-NH2) + 4[H] (LiAlH4, khushk ether) se ring-CH2-NH2 + H2O.
blocks.caption: LiAlH4 se ethanamide aur benzamide ki reduction (kitab ke PDF safha 129 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ne doosre mua'adle mein benzamide aur product dono ki ring mein sirf do double bonds banaye hain, jaise cyclohexadiene ho. LiAlH4 sirf C=O ko CH2 mein badalta hai; benzene ring waisi hi rehti hai. Is liye drawing mein poori benzene ring hai aur product phenylmethanamine (C6H5CH2NH2) hai, jaisa list mein likha hai.

blocks.prompt: Amides amines se kaheen kamzor bases kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Amide ke nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl oxygen par delocalised hai, is liye proton lene ke liye dastiyab nahi.

items: Acyl chlorides + NH3 ya amines (zyada, kamre ka darja) se amides.
Delocalised N lone pair: neutral, C-N 132 pm, sab se kam reactive tezaab derivative.
Hydrolysis (tezaab: RCOOH + NH4Cl; base: RCOONa + NH3); LiAlH4 amines mein reduce karta.
